in_hebrew.name: Marlyn
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Marlyn הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Greek name 'Maryn', meaning 'bitter' or 'rebellious' in Greek, but in Latin, it evolved to 'Marlyn' and came to mean 'gentle sea'.

in_greek.name: Marlyn
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει Gentle sea
in_greek.long_meaning: Marlyn είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. Derived from the Greek name 'Maryn', meaning 'bitter' or 'rebellious' in Greek, but in Latin, it evolved to 'Marlyn' and came to mean 'gentle sea'.

in_latin.name: Marlyn
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat Gentle sea
in_latin.long_meaning: Marlyn est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. Derived from the Greek name 'Maryn', meaning 'bitter' or 'rebellious' in Greek, but in Latin, it evolved to 'Marlyn' and came to mean 'gentle sea'.
